items.source:
Return a RouterFunctionMapping ordered at -1 to map router functions. Consider overriding one of these other more fine-grained methods:
  • addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry) for adding handler interceptors.
  • addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry) to configure cross origin requests processing.
  • configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder) for adding custom message converters.
  • configurePathMatch(PathMatchConfigurer) for customizing the PathPatternParser.
items.translation:
返回一个优先级为 -1 的RouterFunctionMapping来映射路由函数。 请考虑重写以下其他更细粒度的方法之一：
  • addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry)用于添加处理器拦截器。
  • addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry)用于配置跨域请求处理。
  • configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder)用于添加自定义消息转换器。
  • configurePathMatch(PathMatchConfigurer)用于自定义PathPatternParser。

items.source:
Returns a RequestMappingHandlerAdapter for processing requests through annotated controller methods. Consider overriding one of these other more fine-grained methods:
  • addArgumentResolvers(List) for adding custom argument resolvers.
  • addReturnValueHandlers(List) for adding custom return value handlers.
  • configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder) for adding custom message converters.
items.translation:
返回一个用于处理通过注解的控制器方法的请求的RequestMappingHandlerAdapter。请考虑重写这些其他更细粒度的方法之一：
  • addArgumentResolvers(List) 用于添加自定义参数解析器。
  • addReturnValueHandlers(List) 用于添加自定义返回值处理器。
  • configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.ServerBuilder) 用于添加自定义消息转换器。

items.source: Return a global Validator instance for example for validating @ModelAttribute and @RequestBody method arguments. Delegates to getValidator() first and if that returns null checks the classpath for the presence of a JSR-303 implementations before creating a OptionalValidatorFactoryBean.If a JSR-303 implementation is not available, a no-op Validator is returned.
items.translation: 返回一个全局的 `Validator` 实例，用于验证 `@ModelAttribute` 和 `@RequestBody` 方法参数。首先委托给 `getValidator()`，如果该方法返回 `null`，则检查类路径中是否存在 JSR-303 实现，然后再创建一个 `OptionalValidatorFactoryBean`。如果不可用，则返回一个无操作的 `Validator`。

items.source: Custom argument resolvers are invoked before built-in resolvers except for those that rely on the presence of annotations (for example, @RequestParameter, @PathVariable, etc). The latter can be customized by configuring the RequestMappingHandlerAdapter directly.
